definitions: A former township in the municipality of Dysart et al, Haliburton County, Ontario, Canada.

blocks.text: Eyre is a given name. Notable people with the name include:

items: Eyre Coote (1760–1823), Irish soldier, nephew of the above
Eyre Crowe (painter) (1824-1910), British author and painter
Eyre Evans Crowe (1799-1868), British journalist and historian
Eyre Massey Shaw (1830-1908), Superintendent of London Fire Brigade

blocks.text: Eyre is a surname with origins in England.
